overloadMerges.note: Two doc syntax lines differ only in the leading '*' discriminator (object name vs. Variable/Field); collapsed into one overload. Also renamed the trailing optional '*' (distinct literal-symbol parameter, doc note: 'if passed = update expressions before freezing them') to a distinguishable name so it isn't confused with the leading discriminator.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, 'object' below is an object name (pass a string); if omitted, 'object' is a Variable/Field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if '*' passed) or Variable/field reference (if '*' omitted)

params.name: updateBeforeFreezing
params.description: If passed, expressions are recomputed (as with ST COMPUTE EXPRESSIONS) immediately before being frozen; if omitted, the expressions' last-computed values are frozen as-is.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Converts dynamic 4D expressions found in the designated multi-style/4D Write Pro object into static text (or images, for 4D Write Pro), permanently removing the live expression references.
